mapper.select: select r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.created_at, r.updated_at from role r inner join user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.id
mapper.insert: insert ignore into user_role (user_id, role_id) select #{userId}, id from role where code = #{roleCode}
